title: Rigorix History Slice v1
description: ADR-016 anchor-signed history projection: the narrow, verifiable read the cross-run guard consumes in `anchored` mode. The engine's `ExecutionHistory` port returns this projection after the anchor's Ed25519 `sig` verifies; a forged slice is rejected and consequential runs fail closed. Actions mirror the engine `HistoryAction` (never parameter values — SpanPrivacy).

scope.description: The producer/scope the slice covers (e.g. the envelope `producer_id`).

since.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the actions included in the slice.

actions.description: Prior executed actions (newest or oldest order is anchor-defined; ordering is not part of the trust claim).

head_hash.description: `envelope_hash` of the latest envelope covered by the slice — the chain head the anchor attests to.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (hex, 64 bytes) over the canonical slice bytes (`sig` set to null).

historyAction.description: A prior executed action projected from the signed trail (mirrors rigorix-oss `HistoryAction`). Parameter values never appear.

principal.description: Principal that triggered the prior run. Null when the prior run recorded neither author nor attested identity.

effect_key.description: R8/ADR-014 one-way keyed effect hash; null/absent for effect-less runs (which never satisfy an effect-keyed predicate).

x-signing.canonicalization: serde_json::to_string(slice with `sig` = null) — UTF-8 bytes; no map fields.
x-signing.publicKey: 32-byte Ed25519 public key, hex; supplied out-of-band.
